facts.fact: The Access to Information Act was enacted on 20 July 2018 and is the law the Information Commission's November 2025 whitepaper reviews and proposes to amend.

The Information Commission, the oversight body under the Act, is reported to have been issuing orders, decisions and directives under Part VII s.63(1) since 2019, which information holders have ignored; no decision or figure of requests is given, so applied is not recorded.

note: An amendment drafting scheduled by the Attorney General's Office is not a published draft, so no draft fact.
